_about: Public-domain William Rollinson Whittingham, Episcopal Bishop of Maryland, for the Word Hoard: three of his sermons, The Ministry Called to Self-Denial, The Voice of the Lord, and Mammon-Worship. Texts are from Internet Archive scans. Added 2026-10-23 by lane A, round 131 (my pick); Adam may veto the whole shelf. Every printing dated before 1930, so public domain in the US. No uids minted.

whittingham-self-denial: The ministry called to self-denial : a sermon preached at the matriculation of students in the General Theological Seminary of the Protestant Episcopal Church in the United States, on the evening of the third Sunday in Advent, Dec. 15, 1839, in St. Peter's Church, New-York (New York : Xylographic Press, 1840)
whittingham-voice-of-lord: The voice of the Lord: a sermon, preached in St. John's church, Washington (Washington, W. Morrison, 1841)

_excluded.whittingham-edited: Jahn's Introduction, Jewel's Apology, the Apostolic Fathers, Ratramn, Palmer's Church History, Casaubon and Hill are other men's books he translated or edited
_excluded.whittingham-catalogue: the catalogue of his liturgical library is a book list
